Results.ReviewText: We had a Weber grill years ago and loved it. It lasted for ever and the cooking method of a Weber results in moist but done to perfection grilling. We had always wanted to purchase another Weber grill and we were finally able to do so. Needless to say we are once again totally satisfied and thrilled with our new Weber grill. I know there are a lot of grill options out there but if you have never owned a Weber you will never know what you are missing. We added a I-Grill 3 and the meat always comes out to perfection no matter if it’s rare to well done. Weber grills last forever and when they do finally start to wear out you can purchase any replacement part you need from their website. So bottom line this is our second Weber grill and if we live long enough to wear this one out we will for sure have a third. You can’t go wrong with a Weber grill!
Results.Title: Weber is the absolute best grill on the market

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill from Home Depot pre-installed already. So I am not sure how bad the installation is but worth it just picking it up already built. I have owned it for about 3 weeks now and use it 3-4 times a week. Heats up nice and hot, and easy to wipe down and clean after every use on the outside. My only complaint is that the hose for the propane tank is a bit odd and the hose had to be installed sideways for sufficient gas to reach the burners. Other than that, no complaint so far. I purchased the weber igrill 3, and its useful but it has too many bugs, I would stay away from that and just get a reputable aftermarket one. I also wished it was a bit more portable to be able to put it in my truck. The grates are sturdy and leave great grill marks. I make sure to clean the outside when its completely cooled with degreaser to amke sure the side tables and handle stays clean and ready to go for the next use. Definitely recommend webers metal three sided brush to clean the grates. I clean as soon as I remove the majority of  the food. Grill is still hot enough for debris and burned food to clean off easy. Save yourself buying an expensive cover and get a simple cover for 1/2 the price as the weber one. I expect this grill to last me several years.
Results.Title: Great little grill

It's perfect for the two of us but no problem throwing some burgers and hotdogs on for us and the kids also.Its well made, but not the easiest to assemble. The instructions are not the best. We recieved an instruction manual with pictures. It instructed us to download a "better" version, only to find out it's the same thing as the paper manual. I have a little bit of know how and it took me about 2 hours of putting things together and then taking them apart because they were facing the wrong way. But I gave it 5 stars anyways because I'm a nice guy and all n all we really are happy with it. So buy it and pay the guy to assemble it. I'm pretty sure you will be happy with it.

Results.ReviewText: One month & zero complaints. This is my first time away from charcoal and I gotta say I don’t miss it. This grill is perfect for my small deck. The ignition has been instant as advertised! I do a quick preheat (20 mins), and immediately I have a grill at 500-600 degrees. Then I turn it down slightly and within 10 minutes I have tasty hamburgers & hot dogs w/ amazing sear marks. The cooking grates are reversible with a thinner side for fish & veggies (more delicate and thinner sear marks) and the thicker side for beef & chicken, which is brilliant. The Weber App gives you cooking times for everything and wonderful recipes (I love the one for a basil & Parmesan rub for my corn on the cob). Bought my grill at Ace Hardware, who put it together AND delivered it for free so I have no experience with set up. Enjoying the cooking experience. You will too!
Results.Title: A Stove On Your Deck!!!

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
